spaces.comment_data: Data space (type 'data') that holds Data Integration gateway-bound source connections (e.g. the PostgreSQL CDC source). Register/assign the Data Movement gateway to THIS space.

enabledComponents.comment_components: Toggle individual deployment steps on/off. 'docker' controls the Docker Compose stack (Kafka, simulators, and/or DMG gateway per 'docker.profile'). 'predict' creates the Qlik Predict (ML) experiment/deployment. 'pipelines' imports the declarative QTCP pipeline project (Step 13).

docker.comment_profile: Which Docker Compose file to run (infrastructure/): 'full-stack' (Kafka+simulators, docker-compose.full-stack.yml), 'full-stack-dmg' (+ DMG gateway, docker-compose.full-stack-dmg.yml), 'kafka' (Kafka only, kafka/docker-compose.yml), 'simulators' (docker-compose.simulators.yml), 'simulators-dmg' (docker-compose.simulators-dmg.yml), or 'dmg' (DMG gateway only, docker-compose.dmg.yml).
docker.comment_rpm: Only used for the 'dmg'/'full-stack-dmg' profiles: local file path or download URL for the Data Movement Gateway RPM (infrastructure/dmg/gateway/rpmfiles/gateway.rpm). Leave both empty if the RPM is already in place.

dataGateway.name: MCG_DATA_MOVEMENT
dataGateway.comment_dataGateway: Data Movement gateway ID used to bind the PostgreSQL CDC source connection. Get it from Qlik Cloud → Administration → Data Gateways → your gateway row → the 'Data gateway ID' column (click the value to select/copy it). Leave id empty to skip auto-create and set the connection up in the DI project UI instead. Can also be set via the QLIK_DATA_GATEWAY_ID env var.

postgresql.name: MCG WMS Database
postgresql.comment_postgresql: Created as a Data-Movement-gateway-bound replication SOURCE (repsrc_postgresql) when dataGateway.id is set. 'host' must be the PostgreSQL host reachable from the gateway container (Docker service name / host IP).

mysql.name: MCG CRM Database
mysql.comment_mysql: Meridian CRM. Created as a Data-Movement-gateway-bound replication SOURCE (repsrc_mysql) when dataGateway.id is set — unlike the SaaS CRM connector this replaced, it needs no interactive login and the deploy creates it headlessly. 'host' must be the MySQL host reachable FROM THE GATEWAY CONTAINER (compose service name, or the host IP), and 'port' is 3307 on the host because the gateway container itself binds 3306. Inside the compose network it is mysql:3306.

kafka.name: MCG IoT Telemetry
kafka.comment_bootstrapServers: Use localhost:9092 for Docker Compose, or your-broker:9092 for Confluent Cloud / MSK / self-managed
kafka.comment_topics: Two Kafka topics: cold-chain (sensor readings ~1msg/5s) and carrier-events (status updates ~1msg/min)
kafka.comment_securityProtocol: Use PLAINTEXT for Docker Compose local dev, SASL_SSL for Confluent Cloud / production

athena.name: MCG Lakehouse (Athena)
athena.comment_athena: Analytics apps read the Open Lakehouse through this Amazon Athena connection (Glue catalog databases bronze/silver/gold over the lakehouse Iceberg tables). The QVS load scripts LIB CONNECT TO this name. IAM credentials are completed in the Qlik Cloud UI after deploy.

lakehouse.name: MCG Demo Lakehouse
lakehouse.comment_storage: Use 'qlik-managed' or provide S3/Azure Blob/GCS connection details

cdc.name: CDC Cluster
cdc.comment: Handles PostgreSQL change data capture (Pipelines 1-3) and Meridian CRM incremental sync (Pipelines 6-8)

streaming.name: Streaming Cluster
streaming.comment: Handles real-time Kafka ingestion from IoT topics mcg.iot.cold-chain and mcg.iot.carrier-events (Pipelines 4-5)

theme.name: MCG Dark Theme
theme.comment_theme: Upload via Administration → Themes. Contains theme.json, .qext manifest, MCG logos. Colors: Navy #1B2A4A, Teal #0D7C8F, Gold #C4922E, Inter font.

knowledgeBase.name: MCG Operations Knowledge Base
knowledgeBase.description: Operational documents for Meridian Commerce Group — SOPs, policies, incident reports, contracts, and project documentation.
knowledgeBase.comment_space: Framework space the Qlik Answers knowledge base is created in ('shared' or 'data'). Omit/empty -> created in your personal space. Defaults to the shared space.

assistant.name: MCG Operations Assistant
assistant.description: AI assistant for Meridian Commerce Group operations. Ask about procedures, incidents, policies, carrier contracts, and Project Qlarity.
assistant.comment_space: Framework space the Qlik Answers assistant is created in ('shared' recommended). Omit/empty -> created in your personal space.
conversationStarters: What is the procedure for goods receiving?
What happened during the Rotterdam pipeline failure?
What are the cold chain temperature requirements?
What was the lettuce recall and what went wrong?

dataProducts.comment_sourceFile: JSON file with Gold-layer data product definitions (2 products). Loaded automatically by deploy script.

predict.description: Predicts late-delivery risk from the gold last_mile_performance features.
predict.comment_predict: Qlik Predict (ML) via the /api/v1/ml API (the legacy automl-* APIs were removed ~Feb 2026). The deploy creates the experiment (idempotent). Deployment + model activation run once a trained model exists — either set 'modelId' to a trained model, or train the experiment on the gold feature dataset (needs the Open Lakehouse deployed) and re-run. 'space' is 'shared' or 'data'. 'trainingVersion' and 'batchPrediction' are optional pass-through request bodies for POST .../versions (training) and POST .../batch-predictions (the prediction configuration) — supply them once the dataset/model are available, or build the prediction in the Qlik Predict UI.

glossary.comment_sourceFile: JSON file with 25 business glossary terms. Loaded automatically by deploy script.

pipelines.comment_pipelines: Declarative QTCP pipeline project (YAML) imported via the DI Projects API (preview). Bindings for connections/schemas/clusters are resolved automatically from this config; 'bindings' holds exact-key overrides. databaseName defaults to the lakehouse name. Set prepare=true to validate+prepare tasks right after import; run=true additionally starts tasks in dependency order (landing>transform>datamart). attachDatasets resolves gold catalog datasets and attaches them to the matching data products (JSON-Patch /datasetIds); publishDataProducts activates them in the marketplace. Daily schedules live in the YAML (qtcp_tasks/*/schedule.yaml). Round-trip UI edits back to the repo with: npm run deploy:export-pipeline

definitions.name: MCG Supply Chain Operations — Reload
definitions.description: Hourly refresh of the supply chain app (gold data product via Athena)

definitions.name: MCG Delivery Experience — Reload
definitions.description: Every 15 min at :05/:20/:35/:50 — 5 minutes after each Talend CRM QVD drop (deploy/talend), so the validated-address dataset is always fresh

reloadtasks.comment_reloadtasks: appName resolves to the appId automatically at deploy time (apps must exist — run Build Apps first). Set appId explicitly to skip the lookup.

automations.comment_templateDir: Directory containing automation JSON templates (Teams alerts, pipeline health). Loaded automatically.
automations.comment_teamsWebhookUrl: Microsoft Teams incoming webhook URL for alert automations

documents.comment_sourceDir: Relative path from the deploy/ directory to the documents folder containing .docx files

apps.comment_sourceDir: Place .qvf app export files in this directory before running deploy
apps.comment_sheetsViaMcp: sheetsViaMcp=true (default): build-apps creates each app EMPTY — load script only, mapped to the gold data products — and sheets are authored via Qlik MCP prompting (deploy/apps/mcp-sheet-prompts.json, surfaced with copy buttons on the deploy UI Build Apps page). Set false (or run build-apps --build-sheets) for the legacy Engine-API sheet builder.

mcp.comment_mcp: Qlik MCP Server is cloud-hosted (SSE endpoint) — no local install required. Add this to Claude Desktop/Code config.

options.comment_options: dryRun=true will log actions without executing. continueOnError=true skips failed steps.

stewardship.name: Address Cleanup
stewardship.description: CRM contact addresses the bulk validation job could not resolve to GPS. Fed by the UNRESOLVED branch of mcg_crm_address_validate_bulk.
